_comment: Team settings. The SessionStart hook keeps each researcher's CLAUDE.md, skills and shared findings current. Researchers work on their own branch (researchers/<name>), but shared updates land on main -- so a plain 'git pull' would pull only their own branch and they would silently drift. This fetches and merges origin/main into whatever branch they are on. If the merge cannot be done cleanly it aborts, leaving the working tree untouched rather than dropping conflict markers in front of a non-coder; the team-sync skill then resolves it with Claude watching. Requires this folder to be a git clone; for ZIP downloads the fetch fails and nothing happens.

hooks.command: git fetch origin --quiet && (git merge --no-edit --quiet origin/main || git merge --abort) ; true
